control_failures.control_label: exclusion of people from beneath elevated work
mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: trapped hazardous energy found after isolation of HO-9402

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work on HO-9402 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on HO-9402 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically selecting and inspecting lifting gear. HO-9402 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 10 November 2019 a potential incident was recorded on HO-9402 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during shift handover; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
